description: The workspace's CONFIG project: TENANT provisioning only (apiVersion thoryn.io/tenant/v1), no app code. It defines what the tenant is (environments, sign-in methods and flows, branding, email, identity providers, users, roles, custom domain), one section per connection under .thoryn/environments/<connection>/. Its provisioning runs through the stub .github/workflows/thoryn-provisioning.yml, which the creation flow (thoryn project init config, or the Thoryn GitHub App) seeds with each connection's connection.json and .thoryn/workflow.yaml, and which calls thoryn-cli's reusable workflow. This file stays in the repository as the declaration of what the creation flow must set up: the trusts, their scopes and grants, and the GitHub Actions variables.

THORYN_ISSUER.description: Platform base issuer the thoryn CLI signs in to, e.g. https://auth.stg.thoryn.org.

THORYN_WORKSPACE.description: Slug of the Thoryn workspace this project configures.

THORYN_SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT.description: Slug of the first sandbox environment. The production section declares it; the sandbox section configures it.

THORYN_SANDBOX_WIF_CLIENT_ID.description: clientId (wi_...) of the workload identity trust for this repository in the sandbox environment.

THORYN_PRODUCTION_WIF_CLIENT_ID.description: clientId (wi_...) of the PRODUCTION workload identity trust for this repository. The trust pins the GitHub environment, and the variable lives in that environment, so only the production job can read it.

production.description: The production workload identity trust. It pins the GitHub environment github.productionEnvironment (only jobs in it, never a pull request), declares the environments and converges production's own configuration.

sandbox.description: The sandbox's workload identity trust. It converges that sandbox's configuration.
